subject: design/impl-review-host-persistence
statement: The routed-assurance process is exact-incorporated unchanged. Its outer isolated execution returns one typed `ProcessHandoff` through a bounded one-way channel; the trusted host coordinator alone validates it and materializes the canonical completed aggregate. An impl-review-owned host persistence adapter, running outside every reviewer/pass context, preflights its medium capability, durably admits one publication attempt, performs the sole proposal write, exact-reads only the returned native receipt, and appends one EVT-13. The invoking host supplies the obligation/process/proposal/revision binding and distinct attempt-proof reference, consumes the receipt, and appends its separately contracted reciprocal terminal; it never writes the proposal or redefines the report.
